source: Versioned SQL migrations; no shared-stack data read

groups.subjectPath: users.id and external_identities.user_id
groups.projection: identity-profile-v1 partial contribution implemented
groups.blocker: Global account export remains pending; provider subject is personal data, not a provider deletion command

groups.subjectPath: user_id or token.session_id -> sessions.user_id
groups.projection: Only MFA enabled flag in profile; other safe metadata pending, credential material excluded
groups.blocker: Revoke sessions/tokens; never export password hashes, token hashes, MFA ciphertext or recovery hashes as a profile

groups.subjectPath: Encrypted payload contains destination; no relational user_id
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Add authoritative subject linkage before selective purge/export; do not decrypt all users mail indiscriminately

groups.subjectPath: user_id, security_audit FK SET NULL
groups.projection: pending beyond existing own-request/event APIs
groups.blocker: Request CASCADE alone cannot coordinate other services; audit retention/anonymization undecided

groups.subjectPath: grant.user_id; elevation.session_id; audit actor_user_id/subject_user_id
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Revoke grants/elevations and preserve scoped immutable audit according to an approved policy

groups.subjectPath: receipt.request_id -> privacy_requests.user_id; audit.actor_user_id
groups.projection: Metadata only; no exported profile payload stored
groups.blocker: Receipt/audit immutable, request FK restricts parent deletion; retention/redaction requires a separate approved operation

groups.subjectPath: request_id -> privacy_requests.user_id; session_id and access_token_hash -> live subject session
groups.projection: Internal capability hash only; never exported
groups.blocker: 30-second authority lifetime is a technical authorization bound, not a business retention policy; expired metadata cleanup not implemented

groups.subjectPath: request_id -> privacy_requests.user_id; session_id and access_token_hash -> live subject session
groups.projection: Internal project-scope capability hash only; never exported
groups.blocker: Short-lived authorization record; cleanup/retention policy remains undecided

groups.subjectPath: creator_id and memberships.user_id; current owner is memberships.role=owner
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: creator_id is not current ownership after a transfer; do not remove a team or peers assets by historical creator

groups.subjectPath: invitation.email; outbox.id -> invitations.id
groups.projection: pending; exclude invite bearer/hash and encrypted mail payload
groups.blocker: Invitation recipient can exist without membership; reconcile pending delivery before revoke/purge

groups.subjectPath: actor_id and subject_id within shared workspace
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Peer information and retention/anonymization policy require explicit treatment

groups.subjectPath: receipt.user_id; request_id is an external Identity reference, not a cross-database FK
groups.projection: Receipt/hash/capture-time/audit only; current-membership payload is not stored
groups.blocker: Immutable owner-local history needs approved retention/redaction; a prepared contribution never completes the global request

groups.subjectPath: project/upload.creator_id; inspection_requests and upload_parts via upload_id -> uploads.id
groups.projection: Partial project/upload references, basic metadata and state; source/media bytes, hashes and keys excluded
groups.blocker: Workspace owns shared content; multipart part details, inspection state, object references and storage reservations remain for coordinated owner manifests

groups.subjectPath: workspace_id aggregate, not exclusive user ownership
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Cannot zero a workspace quota when one member leaves; reconcile the exact owned reservations/objects

groups.subjectPath: request/pipeline.creator_id; events/outbox.pipeline_id
groups.projection: Partial author-owned work IDs, states, dates and classified error codes; event/outbox payload omitted
groups.blocker: Stop new dispatch, cancel active children and settle storage/consumption before purge; references connect to other owners

groups.subjectPath: creator_id, author_id, approver_id and actor_id; local draft/revision FKs
groups.projection: Revision IDs/action/version/date included only when requester is author; drafts, shared text, peer comments/approvals/grants/audit remain pending
groups.blocker: Shared text/revisions, immutable history and review grants need a policy; revoke grants before content removal

groups.subjectPath: receipt.request_id -> Identity privacy request; receipt.user_id and audit.actor_user_id; external IDs only
groups.projection: Project metadata/reference contribution; no copied media or source payload stored
groups.blocker: Immutable receipt/audit follows owner-local retention and prevents parent request deletion until an approved policy exists

groups.subjectPath: No creator_id; resolve authoritative task/upload references from Project, not every job in a workspace
groups.projection: No personal export. Media has verified retryable cleanup for four fixed output keys of failed/cancelled derivative tasks with cleanup_pending=true
groups.blocker: Source/spec/result references and successful artifacts remain pending; privacy purge needs Project-authorized ownership, worker cancellation and outbox protection against resurrection

groups.subjectPath: analysis_jobs.creator_id and source; outbox.job_id
groups.projection: No personal export; terminal failed/cancelled jobs have retryable cleanup_pending for transcript/selection only
groups.blocker: Source/spec and outbox remain; authoritative Project reference and global deletion coordination are pending

groups.subjectPath: job_id -> analysis_jobs.creator_id
groups.projection: Cleanup deletes transcript and selection data only for failed/cancelled jobs; successful jobs are preserved
groups.blocker: No export; shared-content decisions, downstream editor/review references, and successful-result retention remain undecided

groups.subjectPath: job_id -> analysis_jobs.creator_id
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Reconcile started/unknown external effects before removing evidence; provider retention not decided

groups.subjectPath: Global development configuration; no account subject column
groups.projection: not an account-owned record
groups.blocker: Do not delete a shared plan for an account request

groups.subjectPath: workspace_id aggregate
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Team consumption is shared; no approved personal/financial retention duration

groups.subjectPath: reservation.creator_id; other records via pipeline_id
groups.projection: pending
groups.blocker: Settle open reservations, preserve deduplication and decide immutable ledger retention/anonymization before erasure

outsideSql.subjectPath: Project uploads and Media/Analysis result references
outsideSql.blocker: Sources, MP4/WAV/SRT/VTT, split-screen secondary references and multipart parts; delete by authoritative manifest, not bucket-wide or workspace-only prefix

outsideSql.subjectPath: Job identifiers and owning SQL outboxes
outsideSql.blocker: Deleting Redis alone allows outbox replay; preserve terminal/tombstone semantics and disable resurrection before queue cleanup

outsideSql.subjectPath: Project review links and authorized object references
outsideSql.blocker: Revoke grants and prevent new URLs; account for already issued URLs and in-flight streams without inventing a new retention period

outsideSql.subjectPath: Task IDs/correlation IDs or encrypted delivery payloads
outsideSql.blocker: Temporary cleanup is not deletion of SQL, logs or delivered mail; external provider retention and attribution remain pending

outsideSql.subjectPath: Checkpoint copies of all owners, objects and secrets
outsideSql.blocker: Live erasure does not erase prior backups; approved retention/custody and replay of deletion tombstones after restore are required
